rows.en: (I invited Shirakawa to come train today, but...)

(She hasn't stopped moving this whole time,
so we haven't talked at all...)
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders; 'she' = Miyuki in both.

rows.en:
Ah, looks like she's done.
Nice work, Shirakawa. Here, some water.
Thanks...
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; plain arigatou (not her usual polite form), so 'Thanks'.

rows.en: You look like you're in good form.
Not really...
Really? It didn't look that way to me...
...Did something happen?

Everyone who pairs up with me
ends up having an accident...
Huh? No way...

I think it's because I'm not paying
enough attention to what's around me...
...Shirakawa.

Things I could always do before...
all of a sudden, I just can't do them anymore...

My mind goes blank, and by the time
I realize it, it's already too late.
(This must be a slump...)

You told me before, didn't you, Shirakawa?
That flying through space feels wonderful.
You haven't forgotten that feeling, have you?

You're so serious, Shirakawa.
I think you're overthinking things.

Thinking isn't bad. In fact, you should think.
But if you overthink so much you can't move,
then what's the point?

Why not just move more naturally,
the way it feels right to you?

Well, I'm not exactly in a position
to lecture anyone, though.
rows.notes: Male; erasou na koto ieru tachiba ja nai.

rows.en: That's not true...
It makes me really happy...
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; subject restored (what the player said).

rows.en: You know, I really like...
rows.notes: Male. The Japanese boku wa suki da yo is complete with the object dropped, so Miyuki hears 'I like you'; the object comes in c10842 (inverted sentence). English cannot drop the object, so the line trails and c10842 completes it.

rows.en: ......Excuse me!?
...seeing you work so hard, Shirakawa.

rows.notes: Male, Miyuki; hahi? = a garbled, flustered hai.

rows.en: Wait, what's wrong?

N-no, i-it's nothing...
Well, it's not exactly nothing, but...
You're a weird one...
I don't want to hear that from you!!
Oh, honestly, let's go!!
Huh? Ah! Hey, wait!!

Thank you for today...
I feel like I understand, just a little...
Okay, I'm glad.

(I'm glad she cheered up, even just a little!
I'd better work hard too!)
(I invited Miyuki to come train today, but...)

Ah, looks like she's done.
Nice work, Miyuki. Here, some water.
You look like you're in good form.
......Miyuki.
(Could this be a slump...?)

You told me before, didn't you, Miyuki?
That flying through space feels wonderful.
You haven't forgotten that feeling, have you?

You're so serious, Miyuki.
I think you're overthinking things.

Why not just move more naturally,
the way it feels right to you?
Well, I'm not really one to talk, though.
rows.notes: Female; watashi ga ieru tachiba ja nai.

rows.en: You know, I really like...
rows.notes: Female; same inverted sentence as c10840, completed by c10864.

rows.en: ...seeing you work so hard, Miyuki.
Hehe... Thank you.
rows.notes: Female, Miyuki; kusu' as c10698. Review: Miyuki's kusukusu/kusu is 'Hehe' (as elsewhere).

rows.en: Yeah, let's hang out again sometime.
rows.notes: Female; answers 'Well then, see you later.'

rows.en:
(I'm glad she cheered up, even just a little!
I'd better work hard too!)
(Training with Shirakawa again today.)
(Ah, she's already here. Better hurry!)

\p-kun,
you're late!
rows.notes: Male, Miyuki; as the female c09095.

rows.en: S-sorry... Did I keep you waiting, Shirakawa?
Just kidding. I only just got here myself.

(Looks like she's managed to get
her head back in the game.)
Let's do our best today too.
Sh-Shirakawa... you're pushing way too hard...
You're just a slacker, that's all.
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; anata ga darashi ga nai dake.

rows.en: Y-you think so...?

So let's eat something tasty
and get our strength back.
Oh, sounds good!
Come on, let's go.
Ah, okay, wait for me!!

(There's no stopping Shirakawa
once she's back on her feet.)
(Training with Miyuki again today.)
S-sorry... Did I keep you waiting, Miyuki?
Oh, okay, that's good~
rows.notes: Female; answers 'Just kidding, I only just got here myself.'

rows.en:
(Looks like she's managed to get
her head back in the game...)
M-Miyuki... you're pushing way too hard...
Ooh~ Sounds good, sounds good~!

(There's no stopping Miyuki
once she's back on her feet.)

uncertain: c10840/c10863: 'suki da yo' with the object dropped (Miyuki hears 'I like you'), completed by c10842/c10864 'seeing you work so hard'. English trails 'You know, I really like...' to keep the misunderstanding; the Japanese line itself is grammatically complete.
